title: Inhibition of M2 tumor-associated macrophages polarization by modulating the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway as a possible liver cancer therapy method.
authors: Tsukanov, Vladislav V; Tonkikh, Julia L; Kasparov, Edward V; Vasyutin, Alexander V
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药牛黄通过Wnt/β-catenin通路抑制M2肿瘤相关巨噬细胞极化以治疗肝癌，虽含分子对接但核心为细胞信号通路与肿瘤免疫，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: The problem of liver cancer is becoming increasingly important due to the epidemic of metabolic diseases and persistent high alcohol consumption. This determines great attention to the development and improvement of methods for early diagnosis and treatment of liver cancer. Huang et al presented a study in the World Journal of Gastroenterology, in which they showed that the use of the traditional Chinese medicine Calculus bovis (CB) can suppress tumor growth in mice by inhibiting M2 tumor-associated macrophages (TAM) through modulating the activity of the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway. The interaction of CB components with the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway, M2 TAM polarization, and tumor dynamics were studied using network pharmacology, transcriptomics, and molecular docking. It is now generally accepted that the polarization of TAM and the differentiation of the functions of M1 and M2 phagocytes are of great importance for the progression of neoplasms. It is assumed that M2 TAM promote proliferation and migration of tumor cells. Attempts to medicinally influence the Wnt/beta-catenin pathway in order to modulate phagocyte polarization now belong to one of the most promising areas of immunotherapy of oncological diseases. Undoubtedly, the work of the Chinese authors deserves attention and further development.
abstract_zh: 肝癌问题因代谢性疾病流行及持续高酒精摄入而日益重要，这促使人们高度重视肝癌早期诊断和治疗方法的发展与改进。Huang等人在《世界胃肠病学杂志》上发表了一项研究，表明使用中药牛黄 (Calculus bovis) 可通过调节Wnt/β-catenin通路活性，抑制M2肿瘤相关巨噬细胞 (tumor-associated macrophages, TAM)，从而在小鼠中抑制肿瘤生长。他们利用网络药理学、转录组学和分子对接技术，研究了牛黄成分与Wnt/β-catenin通路、M2 TAM极化及肿瘤动态之间的相互作用。目前普遍认为，TAM的极化以及M1和M2吞噬细胞功能的分化对肿瘤进展具有重要意义。假设M2 TAM促进肿瘤细胞的增殖和迁移。通过药物影响Wnt/β-catenin通路以调节吞噬细胞极化，现已成为肿瘤疾病免疫治疗中最有前景的领域之一。无疑，中国作者的工作值得关注和进一步拓展。
